# CynexAI

> CynexAI is an IT and corporate training institute in Hyderabad offering AI, data science, full‑stack, DevOps, and Python courses with high placement rates and industry partnerships.

## Main pages

- [IT & Corporate Training Institute](https://cynexai.in/): Explore over 500 students trained, a 95% job placement rate, and partnerships with 50+ industry leaders. Join AI, ML and tech programs in Hyderabad.
- [Webinar Portal – Live Sessions](https://cynexai.in/webinar): Join interactive online webinars with industry experts, access recordings, and connect with peers; contact info and location provided for Hyderabad.
- [Photo Gallery of CynexAI Classes & Events](https://cynexai.in/gallery): View images from CynexAI's classes, events, and student activities in Hyderabad, illustrating hands‑on technology training and career‑focused learning.
- [CynexAI Blog – AI, Data Science & Tech News](https://cynexai.in/blog): Read the CynexAI blog from Hyderabad for AI, machine learning, data science and tech insights that match the institute’s industry‑aligned curriculum.
- [Enroll in CynexAI Course – Secure ₹500 Fee](https://cynexai.in/Enroll): Complete the enrollment form for a CynexAI course in Hyderabad, pay the ₹500 fee through Razorpay, and choose your learning mode like recorded classes.
